==Description==
'''Narrator Chill Guy''' is an exclusive sticker obtained from [[The Final Act Event]]. It was obtained from Level 38 of the premium track, which had a cost of {{PlushieSnowman|1,405}} or {{Robux|151}} ({{Robux|120}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale) to unlock it, with a total cost of {{PlushieSnowman|24,055}} or {{Robux|3,366}} ({{Robux|3,366}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale).

==Appearance==
'''Narrator Chill Guy''' showcases the [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]] standing still and smirking.

==Trivia==
*This sticker is based on the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/just-a-chill-guy-my-new-character Chill Guy] meme.
*The sound that plays when the sticker is used plays the first few notes of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DBA8xveVZ8g Lunar Overture].
